items.title: 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds (kuch compounds ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.2 with Quick Check 25.2 answered (PDF 137-139). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Nishan lagi jagah (ester ka C–O bond) par disconnection karne se synthon A aur synthon B milte hain; in ke synthetic equivalents bhi dikhaye gaye hain. Synthetic equivalents chunte waqt yeh dekhna zaroori hai ke yeh aapas mein react kar ke target molecule de sakein.
In synthons ko neutral (charge khatam) kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: acetic acid (synthon A, CH₃CO⁺ ke liye) aur ethanol (synthon B, C₂H₅O⁻ ke liye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step II mein yahan “benzene and nitric acid” likha hai; yeh words aniline wali example ke hain. Ethyl acetate ke synthetic equivalents acetic acid aur ethanol hain, jaisa scheme aur agla sentence batate hain.
Is tarah target molecule ethyl acetate ka disconnection aur phir neutralization humein acetic acid aur ethanol deta hai, jo TM banane ke liye simple starting materials hain.

blocks.alt: Step I: ethyl acetate, C=O wale carbon aur ester oxygen ke bond par wavy slash, 'Disconnection' arrow, phir acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (A) aur ethoxide ion -O-C2H5 synthon (B). Step II: synthon (A) acetic acid (SE) aur synthon (B) ethanol (SE) ke barabar. Synthesis: CH3-COOH + C2H5-OH, H2SO4 ke saath, se CH3-CO-O-C2H5 + H2O.
blocks.caption: Example 25.2.1: ethyl acetate ka retrosynthetic tree aur synthesis (kitab ke page 137-138 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ko oopar se neeche parhein: Step I mein ester ka C–O bond kaata gaya (wavy (lehredaar) nishan), jis se acylium ion (A) aur ethoxide ion (B) bane. Step II mein ≡ ka nishan batata hai ke in ki jagah lab mein kaun se real reagents (SE) istemal honge: acetic acid aur ethanol.
Ab TM ki synthesis jaani pehchani esterification reaction (acid + alcohol se ester banana) se hoti hai: acetic acid aur ethanol H₂SO₄ ki presence mein react kar ke ethyl acetate aur paani dete hain.
